newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays weak but bounces off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays weak but bounces off lows.

text.p: London white sugar futures bounced slightly from earlier lows in heavier Wednesday trade as the nearby December/March spread dominated activity. Trade buying of the spread was offset by commission house selling, keeping values weak but pinned in recent ranges.
"There's decent volume trading but the market isn't doing a great deal," said one trader, adding that the New York raws market was doing little to spur sentiment in London.

At 1619 GMT December was down $1.30 at $322.00 after touching an intraday low of $321.00. March was down $1.20 at $319.00 and overall volume totalled a hefty 3,603 lots, composed of trades in the two front positions.

Technically, December looks to be heading towards support at $320.00 and dragging other positions with it. In late April, December slumped to $320.00 before the start of a four-month bull trend extending up to a new life-high of $349.00 in early September.
In Paris volume was also heavier than usual at 1,018 lots.
December was down $2.30 at $321.50 and March down $1.80 at $319.20.
